i.n: instant lasagne sheets (just one pack for our 20 cm x 30 cm dish)

method.s: Dice onion and vegetables. Fry onion until beginning to soften.
Add other vegetables and fry 5 to 10 minutes until soft. Reserve.
Fry mince. Add vegetables, pasta sauce, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, beef stock, salt, pepper and balsamic vinegar to taste. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
Layer as follows: meat sauce, lasagne sheet, repeat - ending on lasagne sheet.
Mix cottage cheese and cream cheese, and spread over top. Top with edam cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes at 180 deg C, cover with baking paper, then bake another 15 minutes.
